tasks.description: Builds an index of compliance evidence items grouped by control. Use when asked for an index of the compliance evidence items for an audit.
tasks.intent: Index compliance evidence items grouped by control.

tasks.description: Checks the age of each evidence item against its control's maximum age. Use when asked whether compliance evidence is fresh enough for an audit period.
tasks.intent: Check evidence item age against each control's maximum age.

tasks.description: Builds a control coverage matrix from compliance evidence items. Use when asked for a control coverage matrix or the controls that lack evidence.
tasks.intent: Build a control coverage matrix and list controls without evidence.
